latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI Jobs — automate video edits and exports with cloud GPU rendering.

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe editing tasks to receive processed 1080p MP4 videos.
- Supports automated silence cutting, transitions, text overlays, and more via natural language instructions.
- Handles credits, session management, job status tracking, and exports transparently for fast freelance workflows.
- API-based, no local installation required. User authentication with temporary free credits on first use.
- Timeline editing, batch processing, and iterative refinements supported within each session.
